chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ishaq ibn Hareez who said:

A woman asked me to seek permission for her to meet Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), so I sought permission for her and he granted it. She said: 'Inform me about the lesbian (al-lawati), with the lesbian, what is the limit/punishment of what is in it?' He said: 'The punishment of the lesbian is that on the Day of Judgment, they will be brought having been dressed in a garment of fire, covered with masks of fire, and wearing trousers of fire, and pillars of fire will be inserted into their bellies up to their heads, and they will be thrown into Hell.' He said: 'O woman! The first people to do this were the people of Lut. The men became independent of men (i.e., used each other), and the women became independent of men, and the women remained without men, so they did as their men did.'
ai.seo_question: What is the specific punishment for female homosexuality (lesbianism) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to establish the specific eschatological punishment for female homosexuality, detailing vivid imagery of fire-based garments and pillars inserted into the body on the Day of Judgment. The Imam attributes the origin of this practice to the community of Prophet Lut, noting that women adopted the behavior after men began engaging with each other, leaving women without male partners. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that the act is a deviation from natural order, mirroring the transgression of the people of Lut.
